title: No, let me try it first by myself.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Here, let me pour the water for you.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: No, let me try it first by myself.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But the pitcher is too heavy for you.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I can do it if I use both of my hands.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Two hands, then. Set the cup on the low shelf.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: See, Dad? I only spilled a little bit.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: A little spill is fine. Next time you can spill even less.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I can do it all by myself next time.

variations: "pour it" 换 "carry it"；"two hands" 换 "slow steps"。
